scan_angles: arXiv: PEAD + post-earnings drift + text signals

papers_found.title: Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability
papers_found.notes: Drift regime = >60% positive days in trailing 63-day window. S&P 500, 2004-2024, 20-year walk-forward, OOS Sharpe >13. Combines value + short-term reversal conditional on drift regime. Directly actionable as H237 variant of H221 with better drift definition. H221 used declining volume which gave only 3.6/30 eligible stocks; this definition should give ~8-15 eligible stocks per month.

papers_found.title: The GT-Score: A Robust Objective Function for Reducing Overfitting in Data-Driven Trading Strategies
papers_found.notes: Composite objective combining performance + significance + consistency + downside risk. 98% improvement in generalization ratio vs Sharpe optimization. 50 S&P 500 stocks 2010-2024, 9 sequential time splits, 15 random seeds, p<0.01. Applicable to our parameter search in H202-XL, blend ratio selection.

papers_found.title: AlphaAgent: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining with Regularized Exploration to Counteract Alpha Decay
papers_found.notes: Anti-crowding via AST similarity. CSI 500 + S&P 500. GitHub: github.com/RndmVariableQ/AlphaAgent. Key addition: reproducibility audit from arXiv:2605.19337 (15/19 studies R0, no transaction costs) bundled as critical caveat.

papers_found.title: Not All Factors Crowd Equally: Modeling, Measuring, and Trading on Alpha Decay
papers_found.notes: Crowded reversal = 1.7-1.8x crash risk. Crowded momentum = 0.38x crash risk (safer). Hyperbolic decay R^2=0.65. Post-2015 acceleration from ETF growth. Factor momentum Sharpe 0.39. Direct risk flag for H181 (reversal) as crowding signal.

papers_found.title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
papers_found.notes: Systematic review of 77 studies. Reproducibility crisis: 15/19 R0, only 2/19 valid time-consistent splits. Bundled into proposal 3 as caveat. Not a standalone proposal.

papers_found.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
papers_found.notes: FinBERT + fundamentals + price features, Transformer model. Confirms FinBERT benefit for earnings day prediction. No new data source or specific Sharpe numbers. Does not advance beyond H174's confirmed approach.

papers_found.title: Structured Event Representation and Stock Return Predictability
papers_found.authors: Gang Li, Dandan Qiao, Mingxuan Zheng
papers_found.notes: LLM-extracted event features from news for cross-sectional prediction. Cross-sectional, not event-driven PEAD. No earnings-specific focus. No Sharpe numbers in abstract.

papers_found.title: QuantaAlpha: An Evolutionary Framework for LLM-Driven Alpha Mining
papers_found.notes: IC=0.1501, ARR 27.75% on CSI 300. S&P 500 ~19.1% cumulative excess over 4 years. ~995 GitHub stars. Primarily Chinese equities. Similar to H209 AlphaCrafter, bundled into AlphaAgent wiki update as comparison.

papers_found.title: AI-Driven Alpha Decay: Algorithmic Homogenization, Reflexive Signal Erosion, and the Paradox of Intelligent Markets
papers_found.notes: Signal half-life 84->12 months post-AI adoption. H231 already tested this and found it doesn't apply to alpha101 intraday signals. Bundled into factor crowding wiki update as context.
